repos_data.description: A MacOS menu bar app for ChatGPT, Gemini,  Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, DeepSeek, Grok and many more into one streamlined interface
MCP server for xAI’s Grok API with Web/X search, vision, image/video generation and file support
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides access to multiple Large Language Model (LLM) APIs including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Kimi K2, and DeepSeek.
Official MCP server for OrcaRouter — the LLM gateway with auto-routing and fallback chains. Browse models and chat from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client.
Build and publish websites through AI conversation. 27+ MCP tools, OAuth 2.1 auto-discovery. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Mistral/Le Chat, Cursor and more.
